title: NIST WebBook: Hydrogen chloride is ClH, molecular weight 36.461 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Hydrogen chloride as ClH, molecular weight 36.461 amu, CAS 7647-01-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Hydrogen chloride, CAS Registry Number 7647-01-0, lists molecular formula ClH and molecular weight 36.461 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 35.97667771 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/ClH/h1H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
